_meta.openai/widgetDescription: Shows the boundary on a map; do not restate the coordinates.

description: Turns a plain-language description of an area ("Alameda and Contra Costa counties excluding San Jose, plus SFO") or wording from a contract or policy into one validated land-only polygon. An AI agent plans includes/excludes from real administrative boundaries; you get GeoJSON plus each part's source, or a 422 explaining what could not be mapped. Takes 30 s to a few minutes. For a single named place use search_boundaries + get_boundary instead: it is instant and costs 1 unit. Needs an API key or a connected account.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, if known.

seed.description: A point that must be inside the area.

source.description: Who wrote the description (agency, company). Optional context.

name: create_area
title: Create area from a description
